Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-05

1. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
Google unveiled Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a new AI model that can generate and edit 15‑second video clips directly, improves consistency across outputs, and reduces pricing by roughly one‑third.

2. GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
OpenAI released GPT‑6 Cyber, a specialized cybersecurity model that scans code and systems for exploitable bugs and generates remediation suggestions, trained with strict alignment to operate only within permitted boundaries.

3. Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
Daybreak Red, OpenAI’s cybersecurity‑focused offering, has been deployed in AWS GovCloud (US‑East) and is now available to authorized customers via Amazon Bedrock.
